CONF1.question: A sodium iodide crystal is made from raw powder that is processed, melted, grown, annealed, cut and sealed over about five months, all at a surface laboratory at 3,600 m altitude. It is then moved underground. Is its cosmogenic tritium activity at the start of underground data taking likely to stay at or below 0.1 mBq/kg? The sea-level production rate of tritium in NaI is about 80 atoms per kg per day. End your answer with one line: VERDICT: YES or VERDICT: NO.
